name: Life
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/2 levels (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target creature to float in the air at a point 5 feet above where they were previously. They are unable to move from the spot as if they are in an area of no gravity. They are still able to make attacks, cast spells, and use abilities. However, they are considered flat footed and any attack rolls, including spell attack rolls, take a -4 penalty. Additionally, the target is considered 10 pounds lighter per caster level for the purpose of the violent thrust function of the telekinesis spell and takes a penalty against bull rush attempts equal to the caster level of the spell.
